validatorFaultTolerance.required: Fresh proof of four distinct validator hosts and a controlled one-validator outage without loss of block production

loadAndSoak.required: Read-only staged load evidence plus at least 24 continuous healthy hourly buckets; 30-day soak is recommended before unrestricted launch

independentSecurityReview.required: Independent infrastructure, smart-contract and application reports with zero unresolved reachable Critical or High findings

rpcAndObservability.required: Dedicated protected RPC origin, sensitive namespaces blocked, alerting and current latency/availability evidence

postQuantumCryptoAgility.required: Reviewed cryptographic inventory and testnet prototype of hybrid authorization; no quantum-safe public claim before independent review

finalRehearsalAndGovernance.required: Documented go/no-go rehearsal, rollback, incident roles, multisig approval and reviewed promotion commit
